## Inside the Skillz Facebook Community: How Players Get Exclusive Codes and Prizes


- by Skillz
- Aug. 20, 2026
- 4 min read


-
-
-
-


If you’ve ever wondered how some players seem to always be first in line for Skillz live events, the answer is simple: they’re in our Facebook community. This is where we post exclusive live event codes, share prize announcements, and give players a front-row seat to everything happening across Skillz. It’s the fastest, easiest way to unlock access before an event window closes.


## **What Is the Skillz Facebook Community?**


The Skillz Facebook community is a dedicated space we built for players to connect directly with us and with each other. It’s not just another social feed. It’s where we share real-time updates, answer questions, and give our most engaged players a look behind the curtain.


We created this community because we wanted a direct line to the players who make Skillz what it is. Instead of scattering updates across different channels, we centralized the good stuff, including codes, announcements, and player highlights, in one place.


[Join Skillz Players Official](https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1VBK7eFpjL/?mibextid=wwXIfr)


## **What You’ll Find in the Community**


Once you’re in, here’s what shows up in your feed regularly:


**Live event codes.** Before and during events like Blackjack by Skillz and Solitaire by Skillz sprints, we post codes that unlock entry to the action.


**Prize announcements and event schedules.** We share what’s coming up, what’s on the line, and when each event window opens and closes.


**Tips and tricks from other players.** Community members regularly swap strategy, share what’s working for them, and help newcomers get up to speed.


**Winner shoutouts and community highlights.** We celebrate players who compete well and win, and we love spotlighting the community’s biggest moments.


## **How to Get and Use Exclusive Codes**


Getting your hands on a live event code is straightforward. Here’s exactly how it works:


1. **Join the Skillz Facebook community.** This is step one and the only real requirement. Once you’re a member, you’re set up to see every code and update as it drops.


2. **Watch for daily and event posts announcing the code.** We post codes directly in the community, usually tied to a specific live event like a Blackjack by Skillz or Solitaire by Skillz sprint.


3. **Copy the code and enter it in the app during the live event window.** Codes are tied to the event’s active hours, so timing matters. Once you have the code, head into the app and enter it to unlock access.


4. **Compete for real cash prizes.** Once you’re in, it’s all about skill. Play your best and see where you land.


A quick note: codes are time-sensitive. They only work during the active event window, so it’s worth keeping an eye on the community rather than checking back later.


## **Share Your Wins With Us**


Landing a win in a live event? We want to hear about it. Post your testimonials, screenshots, or highlights right in the community so other players can celebrate with you.


We also occasionally feature standout player stories and testimonials on the Skillz website, so sharing your experience could put your story in front of an even bigger audience.


## **Join Us and Never Miss a Code**


The Skillz Facebook community is built for players who want more: more access, more connection, and more chances to compete for real cash prizes through skill-based play. If you’re ready to stop missing out on live event codes, this is where you need to be.


[Join the Skillz Facebook Community](https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1VBK7eFpjL/?mibextid=wwXIfr) and follow us on


[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/Skillz/) for even more updates, behind-the-scenes content, and player highlights.


## **FAQ**


**How often are new codes posted?** Codes are posted in connection with specific live events, such as Blackjack by Skillz and Solitaire by Skillz sprints. The best way to catch them is to keep the community open and check in regularly.


**Do codes expire?** Yes. Codes are only active during their event’s live window. Once that window closes, the code no longer works.


**Is the Facebook community free to join?** Yes, joining the Skillz Facebook community is completely free and open to any player who wants in.


**Can I share my winnings with the community?** Absolutely. We encourage players to post their wins, screenshots, and stories. Some community testimonials may even be featured on the Skillz website.
